definition: the design choices the framework fixes where it could have gone another way

settled:
State value and the group comparison are unweighted sums. The attribution axioms require it, and it lines up with equality of suffering: every unit of harm counts the same whoever carries it.

Standing to be weighted comes from being harmed rather than from having consented to the procedure. Consenting to a procedure is just more causal contribution, already counted, so the split between process consent and outcome consent dissolves.

The harm-weighting curve is linear. Clear, defensible, and the same equality of suffering again.

There is no discounting of future value beyond uncertainty. A perfect oracle needs none, and distant value is lighter only because it is less probable.

Holding a variable away from where it would spring back, ongoing captivity or a device held down, needs no separate clause. Each tick the choice to keep holding is scored against releasing, and the gap is a real per-tick harm.

title: The Dials I Set In My Ethics
